_source.title: 获取矩形
_source.params.primitiveIds: 矩形的图元 ID，可以为字符串或字符串数组，如若为数组，则返回的也是数组

title: Get Rectangle
params.primitiveIds: Rectangle primitive ID, which can be a string or an array of strings. If it is an array, an array is also returned
returns: Rectangle primitive object, `undefined` indicates that the retrieval failed
